scenes.prompt: A huge glowing ball of hot orange and gold star matter floating in dark space, with faint glowing arrows of force pressing in on it from every side, as if invisible hands are crushing it. Dramatic, powerful.

scenes.prompt: Our blue planet Earth floating in dark space, with white clouds and blue oceans, being squeezed smaller by a faint glowing force pressing in from all sides; stars around.
scenes.motion: The Earth shrinks smaller and smaller, crushed from all sides, glowing brighter as it shrinks, until it is a tiny glowing bead. Steady camera.
